hero.quote: “Raw feeding has been annoying since day one. There’s no app that solves the problems I actually need solved – counting how much he really needs to eat, seeing how much he ate, and knowing what the hell is left in the fridge. So I got tired of waiting and made the app myself.”
hero.dog_alt: The dog the app was built for

features.section_subtitle: The pillars the app is built on — a dashboard you arrange yourself, the fridge, the macronutrient overview, and a coach that knows what's in both.
features.f4_desc: Weekly feeding total, macros and each meal on one screen — reorder the modules to put what matters most right up top.
features.f1_title: A coach that knows your fridge
features.f1_desc: Ask what to feed today and the Coach suggests a portion made from exactly what you have at home — respecting the daily limits for bones, organs and muscle meat.
features.f2_title: Nutrition tracked down to the gram
features.f2_desc: Every ingredient has its share of muscle meat, bones, organs and other. Adjust the portion and the overview recalculates instantly.
features.f3_title: Stock you always have at hand
features.f3_desc: Ingredients sorted by type — muscle meat, bones, organs, other — with weights and an overview of what's actually left in the fridge.

blog_section.title: From the blog
blog_section.subtitle: Tips and insights on raw feeding — ratios, ingredient freshness and common mistakes.

blog_page.title: The raw feeding guide
blog_page.subtitle: Ratios, ingredients, common mistakes — everything you need to know before filling the bowl.

blog_page.cta_title: The app does the math for you
blog_page.cta_desc: Macros, bone limits and fridge stock — BarfingApp tracks them all automatically.

foods_page.title: Ingredient catalog
foods_page.subtitle: Every ingredient in the BarfingApp database — with a photo, description and nutrients per 100 g. The same data the app calculates with.

foods_page.omega_no_source: Omega‑3 and omega‑6: no verified source for this ingredient, so no value is shown.

bowl.title: Bowl
bowl.no_targets: Totals only while logged out, your dog's targets appear after login.
bowl.empty: Empty so far. Add an ingredient with the + button on a card or in its detail.
bowl.edit_hint: Click an ingredient in the inventory to change the grams or remove it.
bowl.login_text: Log in and the bowl is compared with your dog's daily ration.
bowl.no_dog_text: You don't have a dog profile yet. The guide takes two minutes.
bowl.tick_note: The tick in the bar is your dog's daily target. Fill past it means the ration is exceeded.

missing.title: An ingredient missing?
missing.desc: Tell us what you can't find in the catalogue. We'll check it and add it to the app's database.
missing.note_placeholder: Optional — where to buy it, why it's worth adding, a link to its composition…
missing.anonymous: Anonymous — we don't store your email or anything that identifies you.
missing.error: The suggestion couldn't be sent. Please try again in a moment.
missing.sent_desc: Your suggestion is in. Once we verify the ingredient, it shows up in the catalogue and the app.

foods_page.cta_title: These ingredients are in the app
foods_page.cta_desc: Pick an ingredient, enter the grams and BarfingApp works out how it fits your dog's daily ration.

download.title: Start feeding with confidence
download.desc: No spreadsheets, no guesswork — just a clear picture of what your dog actually eats.
download.waitlist_success_desc: We'll let you know when BarfingApp is ready to download.
download.waitlist_error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

not_found.title: This page doesn't exist
not_found.desc: The link may have expired, or the page never existed. Maybe the dog ate it.

calc.label: BARF CALCULATOR
calc.title: How much does your dog eat?
calc.subtitle: Calculated per FEDIAF · body condition correction · micronutrients
calc.step_size_sub: Life stage (puppy / adult / senior) is determined automatically from age.
calc.weight_note: Enter the target weight (not current weight if your dog is over/underweight)
calc.age_note: Age determines life stage and feeding percentage
calc.disclaimer: Results are indicative based on FEDIAF guidelines. Actual needs depend on health status and breed. Weigh puppies weekly and recalculate. Consult a veterinary nutrition specialist.
calc.stage_note_puppy: Percentage is based on current weight and decreases with age. Weigh the puppy every week.
calc.stage_note_adult: Percentage based on size × activity × neuter status matrix.
calc.stage_note_senior: Senior gets the 'Couch potato' rate regardless of activity.
calc.cond_over_sub: Ribs hard to feel, rounded shape
calc.cta_app_title: Track portions directly in the app
calc.cta_app_desc: BarfingApp monitors your stock, calculates macros and alerts you what needs to be used.

coach.title: Coach is online
coach.a: Your fridge covers a 430 g portion. Bones are at 60 % of the daily limit, so I added turkey necks.

food.title: Meal 1
food.about_text: Celery is an excellent source of fibre and vitamins with very few calories. It works well as a supplement to a dog's diet and supports digestion.

account.intro_title: Your dog's profile on the web and in the app
account.intro_text: Create a profile for your dog and the site will calculate the daily ration and advise what goes in the bowl. The same account and the same dog then work in the BarfingApp.
account.point_1: The guide takes two minutes: name, weight, age, activity.
account.point_2: Daily ration and bowl composition use the same formula as the app.
account.point_3: Edit your dog in the app any time, the site sees it right away.
account.edit_in_app: Profile edits, the fridge and meal plans live in the app.

wizard.weight_hint: What the dog weighs right now. You can set a target weight below if it is out of condition.
wizard.body_underweight_desc: Ribs and hips visible, no fat cover
wizard.body_ideal_desc: Ribs easy to feel, waist visible from above
wizard.body_overweight_desc: Ribs harder to feel, waist disappearing
wizard.body_obese_desc: Ribs not palpable, fat over back and tail base
wizard.target_weight_placeholder: Leave empty and we will estimate it
wizard.target_weight_hint: The ration is calculated for the target weight — feeding an obese dog for the weight it currently is keeps it there.
wizard.health_hint: Optional. The coach adjusts its advice accordingly — kidneys mean phosphorus, pancreatitis means fat, liver means copper.
wizard.health_vet_note: We do not recalculate the ration from a diagnosis automatically — how far to restrict depends on the stage and is your vet's call. The app only takes it into account when advising.
wizard.feeding_to_target: Calculated for a target weight of {{weight}} {{unit}}
wizard.bowl_hint: You can adjust the ratios, they must add up to 100 %.
wizard.bowl_sum: The total is {{sum}} %, it has to be exactly 100 %.
